dct_title_s: Refugee Camps in White Nile and East Sudan
dct_description_sm: The Microsoft Excel spreads sheet contains point data on refugee camps in the states of Al Gezira, Gadaref, Kassala and White Nile. Data is organized by State, Locality, Camp or Site Name and XY coordinates in Decimal Degrees.
dct_publisher_sm: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), Sudan
